statement: The landed node-liveness semantic owner receives the readiness numeric TimeSource across membership-publication planning and the complete fast-test publish gate passes with its canonical readiness contracts.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Every membership-publication path that evaluates node-liveness semantics consumes ControlPlaneReadinessService.now; no caller-local Date.now fallback, fixture refresh workaround, or planning-owned liveness timer is introduced.

The source repair is limited to the production composition clock edge and publish-gate contract fixtures; Quest 2 planning-generation implementation remains unopened until this repair is independently verified, landed, and published.
